title: Spatial Misallocation of Complementary Infrastructure Investment: Evidence from Brazil
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper

title: How Valuable is the Reliability of Residential Electricity Supply in Low-Income Countries? Evidence from Nepal
abstract: This study uses a contingent valuation approach to value the willingness-to-pay (WTP) for improved service experienced by households in Nepal following the end of the country's load-shedding crisis of 2008-2016. Using a detailed survey of grid-connected Nepali households, the authors calculate the WTP per outage-day avoided and the residential value of lost (VoLL) and analyze their key drivers. Households are willing to pay, on average, 123.32 NR ($1.11) per month, or 65 percent of the actual average monthly bill for improved quality of power supply. The preferred estimates of the VoLL are in the range of 5 to 15 NR/kWh (¢4.7-¢14/kWh). These estimates are below the marginal cost of avoided load shedding, and virtually the same as valuations at the beginning of the load-shedding crisis.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用条件价值评估法，评估尼泊尔家庭在该国2008–2016年负荷削减危机结束后，对服务改善的支付意愿（WTP）。利用对并网尼泊尔家庭的详细调查，作者计算了每避免一个停电日的支付意愿，以及居民的失负荷价值（VoLL），并分析了其主要驱动因素。家庭平均愿意为供电质量的改善每月支付123.32尼泊尔卢比（1.11美元），相当于实际平均月电费的65%。VoLL的优选估计值在5至15尼泊尔卢比/千瓦时（4.7至14美分/千瓦时）之间。这些估计值低于避免负荷削减的边际成本，且与负荷削减危机初期的估值基本相同。

title: Welfare and Environmental Benefits of Electric Vehicle Tax Policies in Developing Countries: Evidence from Colombia
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Developing countries face a major challenge of decarbonizing their light-duty vehicle fleet and transitioning to the broad use of electric vehicles. However, there is little evidence on which policies can most effectively facilitate that transition in these countries, distinguished by relatively low-income consumers and highly concentrated markets that distort vehicle markups. This paper analyzes existing and proposed policies aiming to reduce emissions from new passenger vehicles in Colombia, which has used preferential sales taxes and import tariffs to stimulate hybrid and electric cars sales. Using highly detailed data on vehicle purchases and attributes, the paper estimates an equilibrium model of Colombia’s market that includes a random-coefficients logit demand structure and endogenizes firms’ markups. Using the model to simulate policies, the analysis finds that Colombia’s sales tax and import tariffs have increased hybrid and electric vehicle market shares by 0.9 to 2.7 percentage points at welfare costs of $40-$48 per ton of carbon dioxide reduction. Potentially taxing carbon dioxide emissions rates of new vehicles would have roughly similar welfare costs. The high welfare costs of these policies arise from preexisting distortions caused by market power, which yields large private welfare costs of shifting from gasoline to hybrid and electric vehicles.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家面临着使轻型车辆车队脱碳并过渡到广泛使用电动汽车的重大挑战。然而，关于哪些政策最能有效促进这一转型的证据很少，而这些国家的特点是消费者收入相对较低，且市场高度集中，从而扭曲了车辆加价。本文分析了哥伦比亚现行及拟议的旨在减少新乘用车排放的政策。哥伦比亚曾利用优惠销售税和进口关税来刺激混合动力和电动汽车的销售。本文利用高度详细的车辆购买和车辆属性数据，估计了哥伦比亚市场的均衡模型，该模型包括随机系数logit需求结构，并将企业加价内生化。通过模拟政策，分析发现，哥伦比亚的销售税和进口关税使混合动力和电动汽车的市场份额提高了0.9至2.7个百分点，每减少一吨二氧化碳的福利成本为40至48美元。对新车的二氧化碳排放率征税也会产生大致相似的福利成本。这些政策的福利成本之所以高，是因为市场势力导致的既有扭曲，这使得从汽油车转向混合动力和电动汽车产生了巨大的私人福利成本。

title: Economic costs of electricity load shedding in Nepal
Willingness to pay for electricity access in extreme poverty: Evidence from sub-Saharan Africa
abstract: Improving electricity access in low-income countries is a challenging problem because of the high costs of grid extension and low demand for grid electricity in rural areas. This study elucidates these constraints by analyzing poor households' willingness-to-pay for different types of electricity access, including lower cost off-grid technologies. The theoretical model illustrates how consumer preferences, operational and capital costs of electricity service delivery, and availability of power supply affect households' decisions to acquire electricity technology. These effects are then assessed empirically by estimating beneficiaries' willingness-to-pay for electricity in three low-income countries that have pockets of households living in extreme poverty -- Burkina Faso, Senegal, and Rwanda. Consistent with the theoretical model, the results indicate very low household willingness-to-pay for electricity access, and that willingness-to-pay diminishes as households' income declines. Therefore, the study recommends concentrating in the nearer term on ultra-low-cost decentralized off-grid solar technologies in programs to provide household electricity to the poor in rural areas.
abstract_zh: 由于电网延伸成本高昂，且农村地区对电网电力的需求较低，改善低收入国家的电力可及性是一项具有挑战性的问题。本研究通过分析贫困家庭对不同类型电力接入（包括成本较低的离网技术）的支付意愿，阐明了这些约束。理论模型说明了消费者偏好、电力服务供应的运营和资本成本以及电力供应的可得性如何影响家庭获取电力技术的决策。我们通过估计布基纳法索、塞内加尔和卢旺达三个存在极端贫困家庭聚集区的低收入国家受益者的电力支付意愿，对这些效应进行了实证评估。与理论模型一致，结果表明家庭对电力接入的支付意愿非常低，且随着家庭收入下降而降低。因此，本研究建议，近期应集中推广超低成本的分散式离网太阳能技术，以在农村地区通过相关项目为贫困人口提供家庭用电。

title: Electricity Access and Structural Transformation: Evidence from Brazil's Electrification
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This study proposes a novel supply-side mechanism driving economic structural transformation: grid electrification. Increasing electricity availability affects the reallocation of inputs to more productive activities through generating higher returns and lowering entry costs in sectors with greater infrastructure intensity. The results of modeling and econometric analysis based on Brazil's historical data over the period 1970-2006 confirm that the manufacturing sector benefits the most in these two dimensions, followed by services and agriculture. The expansion of electricity infrastructure explains about 17 percent of this process and 32 percent of the observed increase in GDP per capita. Simulations of a multisector neoclassical growth model with heterogeneous firms help assessing the effectiveness of different electrification policies.
abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种推动经济结构转型的新型供给侧机制：电网电气化。电力可得性的提高，通过在基础设施密集型部门产生更高的回报和降低进入成本，影响投入要素向更高生产率活动的再配置。基于巴西1970至2006年历史数据的建模和计量分析结果证实，制造业在这两个维度上获益最多，其次是服务业和农业。电力基础设施的扩张解释了这一过程的约17%，以及人均GDP观测增长的32%。多部门新古典增长模型（含异质性企业）的模拟有助于评估不同电气化政策的有效性。

title: Modeling Uncertainty in Large Natural Resource Allocation Problems
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: The productivity of the world's natural resources is critically dependent on a variety of highly uncertain factors, which obscure individual investors and governments that seek to make long-term, sometimes irreversible investments in their exploration and utilization. These dynamic considerations are poorly represented in disaggregated resource models, as incorporating uncertainty into large-dimensional problems presents a challenging computational task. This study introduces a novel numerical method to solve large-scale dynamic stochastic natural resource allocation problems that cannot be addressed by conventional methods. The method is illustrated with an application focusing on the allocation of global land resource use under stochastic crop yields due to adverse climate impacts and limits on further technological progress. For the same model parameters, the range of land conversion is considerably smaller for the dynamic stochastic model as compared to deterministic scenario analysis. The scenario analysis can thus significantly overstate the magnitude of expected land conversion under uncertain crop yields.
abstract_zh: 全球自然资源的生产力高度依赖于各种高度不确定的因素，这使得寻求进行长期、有时不可逆投资的个人投资者和政府难以看清其勘探和利用的前景。在分类化的资源模型中，这些动态考量往往得不到充分体现，因为将不确定性纳入高维问题在计算上极具挑战性。本研究提出了一种新颖的数值方法，用于求解传统方法无法处理的大规模动态随机自然资源配置问题。该方法通过一个应用加以说明，即在作物产量因不利气候影响和技术进步受限而具有随机性的情形下，全球土地资源利用的配置。对于相同的模型参数，与确定性情景分析相比，动态随机模型下的土地转换范围显著更小。因此，在作物产量不确定的情况下，情景分析可能会显著高估预期的土地转换规模。

title: Political Dividends of Digital Participatory Governance: Evidence from Moscow Pothole Management
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper

title: Assessing the accuracy of electricity production forecasts in developing countries
Estimating Market Power In Homogenous Product Markets Using A Composed Error Model: Application To The California Electricity Market
abstract: This study proposes a novel econometric approach to estimating market power in homogenous product markets. We use a composed error model to estimate the stochastic part of firms’ strategic pricing equation. This part is formed by two random variables: a traditional error term, which captures random shocks, and a random conduct term, which measures the degree of market power. This approach allows for the conduct parameter to vary flexibly across firms and within firms over time, and avoids ad hoc structural restrictions for identifying firms’ conduct. The empirical application of our approach is based on a well-known California wholesale electricity market dataset, which has been rigorously used to study market power. Our results suggest that realization of market power varies over both time and firms, and reject the assumption of a common or time-invariant conduct parameter.
abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种估计同质产品市场中市场势力的新型计量方法。我们使用复合误差模型来估计企业战略定价方程的随机部分。该部分由两个随机变量构成：一个是捕捉随机冲击的传统误差项，另一个是衡量市场势力程度的随机行为项。该方法允许行为参数在企业之间以及企业内部随时间灵活变化，并避免了用于识别企业行为的临时性结构限制。我们方法的实证应用基于众所周知的加州批发电力市场数据集，该数据集已被广泛用于研究市场势力。我们的结果表明，市场势力的实际表现在时间和企业两个维度上均存在差异，并拒绝了共同且不随时间变化的行为参数假设。

title: Urbanization and land property rights
Effect of climate policies on labor markets in developing countries: review of the evidence and directions for future research
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This study surveys one of the critical welfare aspects of contemplating climate policies in developing countries and their potential effect on workers and labor markets. The existing body of evidence finds that climate policies will likely cause a significant reduction of jobs in fossil-fuel industries. These industries make up a relatively small share of total employment, even in fossil-fuel-intensive countries. Therefore, the effect on aggregate employment will likely be small, especially over the long term, since there will be offsetting gains in other industries. However, most of the literature ignores the key features of developing country labor markets and may significantly misrepresent the dynamics of labor market adjustment to climate policies.
abstract_zh: 本研究综述了在考虑发展中国家气候政策时需要关注的重要福利问题之一：这些政策对工人和劳动力市场的潜在影响。现有证据表明，气候政策很可能导致化石燃料行业的大量就业减少。即使在化石燃料密集型国家，这些行业在总就业中所占比例也相对较小。因此，对总就业的影响很可能不大，尤其是在长期，因为其他行业将产生相应的就业增长。然而，大多数文献忽视了发展中国家劳动力市场的关键特征，可能严重歪曲了劳动力市场对气候政策的调整动态。

title: Why are connection charges so high? an analysis of the electricity sector in Sub-Saharan Africa
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This study develops and structurally estimates a model of household and electric utility behavior to describe how the low access rates and high connection charges that are common in the Sub-Saharan Africa region arise from regulated electricity tariffs being set too low. As a result, the utilities lose money on each connected customer and low electricity consumption by households makes it difficult to recover the cost of providing a connection. For each possible choice of the regulated tariff, the optimal upfront connection charge is computed that will maximize profits for the utility in its service territory. Higher tariffs are associated with lower optimal connection charges and higher electrification rates. Nonetheless, due to households' low willingness to pay for electricity services, the equilibrium electrification rates in the model are much lower than 100 percent. Future advances in electrification will require higher incomes, increased coverage of the distribution network, and lower connection costs.
abstract_zh: 本研究建立并结构性估计了一个家庭与电力公用事业公司行为的模型，以描述撒哈拉以南非洲地区普遍存在的低接入率和高接入费如何产生，其原因在于受管制的电价定得过低。结果是，公用事业公司在每个接入的客户身上都会亏损，而家庭的低用电量又使得收回接入成本变得困难。对于受管制电价的每一种可能选择，我们都计算出能使公用事业公司在其服务区域内利润最大化的最优前期接入费。电价越高，最优接入费越低，电气化率越高。尽管如此，由于家庭对电力服务的支付意愿较低，模型中的均衡电气化率远低于100%。未来电气化的推进将需要更高的收入、更广泛的配电网络覆盖以及更低的接入成本。

title: A nonlinear certainty equivalent approximation method for dynamic stochastic problems
Contracting for the second best in dysfunctional electricity markets
abstract: Power pools constitute a set of sometimes complex institutional arrangements for efficiency-enhancing coordination among power systems. In many developing countries, where such institutional arrangements can't be established over the short term, there still can be scope for voluntary electricity-sharing agreements among power systems. Using a particular type of efficient risk-sharing model with no commitment we demonstrate that second-best coordination improvements can be achieved with low to moderate risks of participants leaving the agreement. In the absence of an impartial market operator who can observe production fluctuations in connected power systems, establishing quasi-markets for trading excess electricity helps to achieve some cooperation in mutually beneficial electricity sharing.
abstract_zh: 电力联营体是一套有时较为复杂的制度安排，旨在促进电力系统之间效率提升的协调。在许多发展中国家，短期内难以建立此类制度安排，但电力系统之间仍有可能达成自愿的电力共享协议。我们利用一类无承诺的有效风险分担模型证明，当参与者退出协议的风险处于较低至中等水平时，次优协调改进即可实现。在缺乏能够观察相连电力系统生产波动的公正市场运营商的情况下，建立用于交易富余电力的准市场，有助于在互利的电力共享中实现一定程度的合作。

title: Governors matter
Sustainability of solar electricity: The role of endogenous resource substitution and cross-sectoral responses
abstract: This study seeks to understand how materials scarcity and competition from alternative uses affects the potential for widespread deployment of solar electricity in the long run, in light of related technology and policy uncertainties. Simulation results of a computable partial equilibrium model show that materials scarcities constrain the expansion of solar generation. Solar photovoltaics expand with higher energy demand, squeezing consumption in industries that compete for scarce minerals. Stringent climate policies hamper growth in intermittent solar photovoltaics backed by fossil fuel powered plants, which is not compensated by small increases in non-intermittent concentrated solar power capacity. These findings underscore the significance of developing cost-effective alternatives to critical materials and low-cost electricity storage for economically sustainable climate change mitigation.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在理解在相关技术和政策不确定性的背景下，材料稀缺性以及与其他用途的竞争如何影响太阳能发电在长期内广泛部署的潜力。一个可计算局部均衡模型的模拟结果表明，材料稀缺性制约了太阳能发电的扩张。太阳能光伏随着能源需求的增加而扩张，挤压了争夺稀缺矿产的行业的消费。严格的气候政策会阻碍间歇性太阳能光伏的增长（其背后由化石燃料电厂支撑），而这一减少并未被非间歇性聚光太阳能发电（CSP）装机容量的小幅增长所弥补。这些发现凸显了开发具有成本效益的关键材料替代品和低成本电力储能技术，对于经济上可持续的气候变化减缓的重要性。

title: Public infrastructure and structural transformation
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper

title: Confronting the Food-Energy-Environment Trilemma: Global Land Use in the Long Run
abstract: Economic, agronomic, and biophysical drivers affect global land use, so all three influences need to be considered in evaluating economically optimal allocations of the world's land resources. A dynamic, forward-looking optimization framework applied over the course of the coming century shows that although some deforestation is optimal in the near term, in the absence of climate change regulation, the desirability of further deforestation is eliminated by mid-century. Although adverse productivity shocks from climate change have a modest effect on global land use, such shocks combined with rapid growth in energy prices lead to significant deforestation and higher greenhouse gas emissions than in the baseline. Imposition of a global greenhouse gas emissions constraint further heightens the competition for land, as fertilizer use declines and land-based mitigation strategies expand. However, anticipation of the constraint largely dilutes its environmental effectiveness, as deforestation accelerates prior to imposition of the target.
abstract_zh: 经济、农学和生物物理驱动因素都会影响全球土地利用，因此在评估世界土地资源的经济最优配置时，需要同时考虑这三种影响。一个在未来一个世纪内应用的动态、前瞻性优化框架表明，尽管近期的一些毁林是最优的，但在没有气候变化管制的情况下，到本世纪中叶，进一步毁林的吸引力将消失。尽管气候变化带来的不利生产率冲击对全球土地利用的影响有限，但这些冲击与能源价格的快速增长相结合，将导致大规模毁林，以及比基准情景更高的温室气体排放。全球温室气体排放约束进一步加剧了对土地的竞争，化肥使用量下降，而基于土地的减缓策略则有所扩大。然而，对约束的预期在很大程度上削弱了其环境效果，因为在目标实施之前，毁林会加速进行。

title: What Is the Social Value of Second Generation Biofuels?
Capital adjustment and the optimal fuel choice
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This paper analyzes the important, yet often ignored, link between capital adjustment and the choice of fuels used by manufacturing firms. A novel econometric framework, which explicitly incorporates heterogeneous fuel-using capital stocks in the estimation of optimal fuel choice, is applied to a large panel of Irish manufacturing firms. The econometric estimates show a significant variation in the optimal response of capital to changing fuel prices across different fuel-using technologies. For all the technologies, significant costs to capital adjustment are found. The costs are much larger compared with earlier estimates of adjustment costs based on lagged values of output and fuel prices. The findings imply that the path to full adjustment of capital stocks in response to changing fuel prices may be much longer than was previously thought.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了资本调整与制造企业燃料选择之间重要却常被忽视的联系。我们将一个新颖的计量框架（明确纳入了使用异质燃料的资本存量，以估计最优燃料选择）应用于一个大型爱尔兰制造企业的面板数据。计量估计结果显示，不同燃料使用技术下，资本对燃料价格变化的最优反应存在显著差异。对于所有技术，都发现存在显著的资本调整成本。这些成本远高于此前基于产出和燃料价格滞后值的调整成本估计。研究结果表明，资本存量对燃料价格变化作出充分调整的路径，可能比此前所认为的要长得多。

title: Effects of prepayment regulations on termination of subprime mortgages
Fossil fuel producing economies have greater potential for industrial interfuel substitution
abstract: This study extends the literature on interfuel substitution by investigating the role of transactions costs and technological adjustment, focusing specifically on differences across countries with different potential for fossil fuel production. We find that fossil fuel producing economies have higher elasticities of interfuel substitution. Our simulations show that, compared to the baseline case of uniform elasticities, energy and climate policies result in a greater substitution among different sources of energy for countries with larger potential to produce fossil fuels. These results are important because they imply lower economic cost for policies aimed at climate abatement and more efficient utilization of energy resources in energy-intensive economies. Keywords: climate policies, dynamic linear logit, energy subsidies, fossil fuel production, GTAP-E model, interfuel substitution JEL: E22, H25, Q41
abstract_zh: 本研究通过考察交易成本和技术调整的作用，拓展了关于燃料间替代的文献，重点关注具有不同化石燃料生产潜力的国家之间的差异。我们发现，化石燃料生产型经济体具有更高的燃料间替代弹性。模拟结果表明，与各国弹性一致的基准情形相比，能源和气候政策在化石燃料生产潜力较大的国家会导致不同能源来源之间更大程度的替代。这些结果十分重要，因为它们意味着，针对气候减排的政策成本更低，且能源密集型经济体的能源资源利用更为高效。关键词：气候政策；动态线性logit；能源补贴；化石燃料生产；GTAP-E模型；燃料间替代 JEL：E22, H25, Q41

title: Assessing energy price induced improvements in efficiency of capital in OECD manufacturing industries
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: To assess how capital stocks adapt to energy price changes, it is necessary to account for the impacts on different vintages of capital and to account separately for price-induced and autonomous improvements in the energy efficiency of capital stock. The results of econometric analysis for five manufacturing industries in 19 OECD countries between 1990 and 2005 indicate that higher energy prices resulted in smaller energy use due to both improved energy efficiency of capital stock and reduced demand for the energy input. The investment response to energy prices varied considerably across manufacturing industries, being more significant in energy-intensive sectors. The results of policy simulations indicate that a carbon tax can deliver significant reductions in energy consumption in the medium run with modest declines in energy-using capital stock.
abstract_zh: 要评估资本存量如何适应能源价格变化，有必要考虑其对不同资本vintage（投资批次）的影响，并区分由价格诱导的能源效率改进与自发的能源效率改进。对19个OECD国家1990至2005年间五个制造行业的计量分析结果表明，较高的能源价格通过提高资本存量的能源效率和减少对能源投入的需求，导致了能源使用量的下降。投资对能源价格的反应在不同制造行业之间差异显著，在能源密集型行业中更为明显。政策模拟结果表明，碳税可以在中期内显著减少能源消费，同时能源使用性资本存量仅有小幅下降。

title: The Economic Effects of Legal Restrictions on High-Cost Mortgages
venue: Journal of Real Estate Finance and Economics

title: The effect of climate and technological uncertainty in crop yields on the optimal path of global land use
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: The pattern of global land use has important implications for the world's food and timber supplies, bioenergy, biodiversity and other eco-system services. However, the productivity of this resource is critically dependent on the world's climate, as well as investments in, and dissemination of improved technology. This creates massive uncertainty about future land use requirements which compound the challenge faced by individual investors and governments seeking to make long term, sometimes irreversible investments in land conversion and land use. This study assesses how uncertainties associated with underlying biophysical processes and technological change in agriculture affect the optimal profile of land use over the next century, taking into account the potential irreversibility in these decisions. A novel dynamic stochastic model of global land use is developed, in which the societal objective function being maximized places value on food production, liquid fuels (including bio-fuels), timber production, and biodiversity. While the uncertainty in food crop yields has anticipated impact, the resulting expansion of crop lands and decline in forest lands is relatively small.
abstract_zh: 全球土地利用格局对世界的粮食和木材供应、生物能源、生物多样性及其他生态系统服务具有重要影响。然而，该资源的生产力关键取决于全球气候，以及对改良技术的投资和推广。这为个人投资者和政府寻求进行长期、有时不可逆的土地转换和土地利用投资带来了巨大的不确定性，并加剧了其面临的挑战。本研究评估了农业中与生物物理过程和技术变革相关的不确定性如何影响未来一个世纪的最优土地利用路径，并考虑了这些决策中潜在的不可逆性。我们构建了一个新颖的全球土地利用动态随机模型，其中被最大化的社会目标函数赋予粮食生产、液体燃料（包括生物燃料）、木材生产和生物多样性以价值。尽管粮食作物单产的不确定性具有预期的影响，但由此导致的耕地扩张和林地减少相对较小。

abstract: This paper documents the prevalence of in-house generation of electric power by firms in Sub-Saharan Africa and attempts to identify the underlying causes. The analysis is based on two data sources. The UDI World Electric Power Plants Data Base (WEPP), a global inventory of electric power generating units, provides a detailed inventory of in-house generation at the country level. The World Bank's Enterprise Survey Database captures business perceptions of the obstacles to enterprise growth for 8,483 currently operating firms in 25 African countries. Overall, so-called own generation by firms-which has been on the rise in recent years-accounts for about 6 percent of installed generation capacity in Sub-Saharan Africa (equivalent to at least 4,000 MW of installed capacity). However, this share doubles to around 12 percent in the low-income countries, the post-conflict countries, and more generally on the Western side of the continent. In a handful of countries own generation represents more than 20 percent of capacity. Rigorous empirical analysis shows that unreliable public power supplies is far from being the only or even the largest factor driving generator ownership. Firm characteristics have a major influence-in particular, the probability of owning a generator doubles in large firms relative to small ones. Our model predicts that the prevalence of own generation would remain high (at around 20 percent) even if power supplies were perfectly reliable, suggesting that other factors, such as emergency back-up and export regulations, play a critical role in the decision to own a generator.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了撒哈拉以南非洲企业自备发电的普遍程度，并试图识别其背后的根本原因。分析基于两个数据来源。UDI全球发电机组数据库（WEPP）提供了全球发电机组的清单，在国家层面详细列出了自备发电情况。世界银行企业调查数据库则收集了25个非洲国家8,483家在营企业对企业增长障碍的认知。总体而言，近年来不断增长的所谓企业自备发电，约占撒哈拉以南非洲装机发电容量的6%（相当于至少4,000兆瓦的装机容量）。然而，在低收入国家、冲突后国家以及非洲大陆西部地区，这一比例翻倍，约为12%。在少数国家，自备发电占装机容量的比例超过20%。严谨的实证分析表明，公共电力供应不可靠远非导致企业拥有发电机的唯一因素，甚至也不是最大因素。企业特征有重大影响，特别是大企业拥有发电机的概率是小企业的两倍。我们的模型预测，即使电力供应完全可靠，自备发电的普遍程度仍将维持在约20%的高水平，这表明应急备用和出口监管等其他因素在拥有发电机的决策中起着关键作用。
